data.name: Reynold
data.long_meaning: The name Reynold is derived from the Old German words ‘hrod’ meaning ‘fame’ and ‘wald’ meaning ‘rule’. The name can be interpreted as ‘ruler with renown’ or ‘counselor of great power’. In the Middle Ages, Reynold was a popular name for noblemen and knights.

The name Reynold represents strength, power, and renown, making it an attractive choice for those who desired to embody these qualities.
